Reference / runtime/debug

runtime/debug#

The native layer under debug/dumper, testing/check: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under debug/dumper, testing/check: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native data_dump#

native data_dump(value is any) is string

Diagnostic boundary of core.debug and debug/dumper: values are described, never changed. data_dump formats scalars, enums, arrays and maps recursively. Objects, actions, futures, native handles and failures (including nested ones) fail with an unsupported kind/type diagnostic. For structured inspection use import "debug/dumper" take Dumper; then Dumper(value).all().

native data_kind#

native data_kind(value is any) is string

Value category: int, float, rat, bool, byte, char, string, enum, array, map, object, action, future, failure, native.

native data_type#

native data_type(value is any) is string

Runtime type name: Point, Box<int>, @int, %string:int; an empty collection has element type ?, mixed elements give (A | B).

native data_size#

native data_size(value is any) is int

Elements of an array or map, characters of a string, fields of an object; 0 for other values.

native data_leaf#

native data_leaf(value is any) is string

One-line text of a value that is not looked into: literals of scalars and enums, <action>, <future: done>, <native>, <failure: Panic: x>.

native data_names#

native data_names(value is any) is @string

Field names of an object, in declaration order.

native data_keys#

native data_keys(value is any) is @any

Keys of a map, in map order.

native data_items#

native data_items(value is any) is @any

Elements of an array, values of a map, field values of an object.
